rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for understanding an event only after it has happened.

example.english: With hindsight, I should have set off earlier that day.
example.traditional: 有咗後見之明，先知當日應該早啲出發。
example.jyutping: jau5 zo2 hau6 gin3 zi1 ming4 sin1 zi1 dong1 jat6 jing1 goi1 zou2 di1 ceot1 faat3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone seems wise only after the outcome is known.

example.english: Saying you knew it all along now is just hindsight.
example.traditional: 你而家先話一早知，咪又係事後孔明囉。
example.jyutping: nei5 ji4 gaa1 sin1 waa6 jat1 zou2 zi1 mai6 jau6 hai6 si6 hau6 hung2 ming4 lo1

rows.note: Use this more conversational phrase when the focus is on realizing something only afterward.

example.english: It was only hindsight; who could have guessed there would be a traffic jam?
example.traditional: 都係事後先知，嗰陣邊有人估到會塞車呀？
example.jyutping: dou1 hai6 si6 hau6 sin1 zi1 go2 zan6 bin1 jau5 jan4 gu2 dou2 wui5 sak1 ce1 aa3
